source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 3 summary (PDF 87).

blocks.text: Is chapter ne algorithms aur masail ke hal ka taaruf karaya: computational masail ki tareef aur unhein hal-pazeer ya na-qabil-e-hal aur tractable ya intractable mein baantna; generate and test tareeqa; search, sorting, optimization aur decision jaise masail; greedy algorithms, divide and conquer, dynamic programming aur backtracking jaisi design techniques; aam algorithms; aur Big O notation se kaarkardagi aur complexity ka jaiza. Algorithmic soch ka matlab har masle ki zaroorat ke mutabiq faidon aur nuqsanaat mein tawazun karna hai.
